layout.placement: Anchor main sofa to selected wall while keeping structural openings accessible.
Center compact coffee table within seating area and clear circulation.

decorRestrictions.rule: Do not place furniture or decor that blocks any door/walkthrough opening.
Do not block closet doors and do not place wall art/decor above closet-door regions.

rules: Furniture may extend beyond frame boundaries when composition is natural.
Do not force the full anchor furniture item to be visible.
